newsitem.title: GERMANY: Group of 23 banks to place Lufthansa shares.
newsitem.headline: Group of 23 banks to place Lufthansa shares.

text.p: A global consortium of 23 banks will place the German government's remaining 36 percent stake in airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG with investors, the Bonn transport ministry said on Wednesday.

The global coordinators for the issue are Dresdner Kleinwort Benson and SBC Warburg, with Kleinwort acting as speaker of the consortium and leading the German book while SBC Warburg will lead the international book, the ministry said in a statement.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG), DG Bank and Merrill Lynch form the second tier of issuers, with DMG as senior co-lead manager.
In addition there will be 10 co-lead managers in Germany and eight outside Germany, the ministry said.
"The inclusion of additional banks in a German sales group is being discussed," the ministry said.
